owner_approved_scope: Create a new martial-arts/stealth/skating street-culture gang and keep supplied Spotify recording as its first owner-selected must-add.
interpretation_note: Owner may be blending Chinese wuxia/Shaolin-inspired action with Japanese ninja/shinobi. Ninja/shinobi is Japanese; wuxia and Shaolin reference Chinese traditions. Do not assert one cultural identity or a canonical gang name before owner chooses.

name_candidates.name: Wuxistas
name_candidates.why: Wuxia-inspired and matches the existing -istas naming family

name_candidates.name: Shinobistas
name_candidates.why: Strongest overt ninja identity and same -istas naming pattern

name_candidates.name: Shaolistas
name_candidates.why: Recognizable martial-arts reference with playful -istas suffix; cultural history to research respectfully

name_candidates.name: Shadowlotus
name_candidates.why: Original mysterious style without pretending Chinese and Japanese traditions are identical

name_candidates.name: Jade Strikers
name_candidates.why: Graphic-friendly street gang name and action feel

gameplay_aesthetic: high-velocity skate and precision parkour challenges
reversible rooftop/pagoda-inspired traversal courses with original structures
stealth-to-reveal crew encounters, wall runs and rail/grind transitions where supported
expressive martial dance, acrobatics and music-driven rival responses
distinct original graffiti, cloth motion and cinematic-but-controllable action
style_direction.cultural_scope_note: Design with specific cultural references, properly researched art/movement and original assets; do not interchange Chinese and Japanese language/costumes as a generic Asian stereotype.
not_approved: leader, roster, AI and final abilities

must_include_music.title: USAIN
must_include_music.genre_reference: Russian-language rap / hip hop; not a Chinese-language or Japanese-language track
must_include_music.genre_source_status: independent release listings; no direct listening or BPM analysis performed
must_include_music.content_advisory: Mature/explicit listing reported by Zvuk; verify streaming edition and ratings before future in-game use
must_include_music.version_note: The user-selected Spotify ID locks the intended song; same-title edits, intros, remixes, bootlegs or different editions do not substitute without owner approval. Distributor/Spotify ISRC and exact mix/master require verification.
